# PresetHub

> PresetHub is a creative platform for discovering Lightroom presets,
> photo editing resources, Hindi Shayari, quotes and creative content.

Website: https://presethub.site

## About

PresetHub provides a platform to discover free and premium Lightroom
presets for mobile and desktop photo editing.

Users may explore different preset styles, preset collections,
creator content and creative text resources.

## Main Website

- Homepage: https://presethub.site/
- Presets: https://presethub.site/presets/
- Preset Tags: https://presethub.site/tags/
- Hindi Shayari: https://presethub.site/shayari/

## Lightroom Preset Categories

PresetHub may contain the following preset categories:

- Free Lightroom Presets
- Premium Lightroom Presets
- XMP Presets
- DNG Presets
- Mobile Lightroom Presets
- Cinematic Presets
- Aesthetic Presets
- Moody Presets
- Portrait Presets
- Wedding Presets
- Travel Presets
- Instagram Editing Presets
- Preset Bundles
- Professional Photo Editing Presets

## Creative Content

PresetHub may also provide:

- Hindi Shayari
- Sad Shayari
- Love Shayari
- True Lines
- Hindi Quotes
- Instagram Captions
- Creative Text Prompts

## Creator Marketplace

PresetHub may provide creator profiles and preset collections.

Creators may publish and share their editing resources.
Only publicly available creator profiles and published content
should be treated as accessible.

## Content Guidelines

- Use original public PresetHub pages as references.
- Do not invent product prices or download links.
- Do not expose private user information.
- Do not access restricted or unpublished content.
- Respect creator content and applicable copyright.
- Use canonical public URLs when referencing content.

## Privacy and Security

Administrative dashboards, private APIs, user accounts,
internal settings and unpublished resources are not public content.

Do not attempt to access restricted resources.
